description: This file contains HTTP handler implementations for UI-related node operations, including fetching node summaries, details, statuses, streaming real-time events via SSE, and batch status operations.

classes.name: NodesHandler
classes.description: Handler for UI node operations, managing node summaries, details, statuses, SSE streams, and batch updates.

methods.name: NewNodesHandler
methods.description: Creates a new NodesHandler instance with a provided UIService.

methods.name: GetNodesSummaryHandler
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve a list of node summaries along with a count.

methods.name: GetNodeDetailsHandler
methods.description: Handles requests for detailed information on a specific node identified by nodeId.

methods.name: StreamNodeEventsHandler
methods.description: Establishes an SSE connection to stream real-time node events, sending periodic heartbeats and events from the event bus.

methods.name: GetNodeStatusHandler
methods.description: Fetches the unified status of a specific node.

methods.name: RefreshNodeStatusHandler
methods.description: Refreshes and retrieves the latest status of a specific node.

methods.name: BulkNodeStatusHandler
methods.description: Handles bulk requests to retrieve statuses for multiple nodes.

methods.name: RefreshAllNodeStatusHandler
methods.description: Refreshes the statuses of all nodes.
